scope.reason: Replay reads the stored source envelope and document objects through the ingestion parser, verifying each recorded digest and length; parser output is unchanged and the parsed decision has no feature storage of its own. Revalidate deferred stored PDF payloads through the shared typed corpus-validation result; invalid textless structure is a classified no-document outcome, while readable source text and AST retain the same parser. Preserve PDF paragraph gaps, lettered items and the bounded first-page metadata table when rebuilding document text and block boundaries from captured PDF bytes. Rows without captured PDF bytes yield a metadata-only replay outcome and retain their applied parser version; populated historical rows require an explicit PDF capture refresh. Metadata-derived titles require extracted document blocks. Paragraph-gap thresholds derive from font metrics rather than the frequency of observed gaps. Recompute printed paragraph labels from stored raw: local duplicate or OCR markers preserve surrounding labels, and Czech and Slovak separate opinions have independent numbering scopes; AST roles and labels have no separate feature storage. Re-read legacy, suffixed and Unicode Adobe Glyph List names from stored PDF bytes; extraction has no separate feature storage. Read words the court sets letter-spaced as words, keeping the wider gap between two of them as the word boundary; paragraph text has no separate feature storage. Paragraph text and block boundaries are recomputed from stored PDFs through the shared hard-wrap reader, preserving first-line and hanging indentation, line pitch and short final lines; multiline titles and all block anchors are rebuilt with document-unique identities; none has feature storage of its own. Read letter-spaced emphasis through the one shared reading, once a paragraph's lines are joined: a short spaced word in a text that spaces words, a row of one-letter words no sentence writes, and uneven chunks the document prints nowhere else read as the words they spell; only whitespace in block text changes and it has no feature storage of its own. The formula a court decides under (V MENE SLOVENSKEJ REPUBLIKY), set in the title's type, is read apart from the title as an opening paragraph from the stored PDF bytes; the AST has no separate feature storage. Every row of the portal's metadata box printed above the decision is front matter. Printed paragraph labels are read by one grammar: a label opens a paragraph except inside a date wrapped after its day or after a word its number belongs to, sub-paragraphs (`5.5.`) open their own and count as items beside the court's numbering, and positioned-line paragraphs are read by the one line-join owner; block text, boundaries and numbers are recomputed from stored raw and have no feature storage of their own.
